This is📍Perhentian Kecil in Malaysia 🇲🇾 

There are two Perhentian islands, which are nothing short of tropical Paradise. A lot of Indians travel to Malaysia but never even hear about these islands. Whether you are a solo traveller, in couple or travelling with family, both these islands make the perfect choice for a tropical getaway.

These islands are known for their:
✅ crystal-clear turquoise waters
✅ white-sand beaches and
✅ abundant marine life

You can swim with the turtles and also spot reef sharks 💕
